title: reachability-pod scan request v1
description: OCSF 1.9.0 Scan Activity (class_uid 6007) as accepted by reachability-pod on POST /api/v1/scans and appsec.reachability.requests.v1 (architecture.md 5.1, 5.4a; D-002, D-023, D-028). Draft until the phase 0 freeze (R15). Other OCSF top-level fields are allowed and ignored; unmapped.reachability is closed.

time.description: Event time, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

version.description: OCSF version; the service is built against 1.9.0.

uid.description: Idempotency key; a resubmission returns the existing scanId. Optional but strongly recommended: without it every submission creates a new scan. Echoed as correlation_uid.

commit.description: Full 40-hex commit SHA, lowercase. Branch names and short SHAs are rejected.

uuid.description: Optional. Must match the name/version lookup, checked at claim time; a mismatch fails the scan with DT_UUID_MISMATCH, no retry.

priority.description: Priority class name. Unknown names, and classes above default without the reach-priority-<class> role, fall back to default (architecture.md 5.4a j).

formats.description: Default: all three. summary.json is always written.

dt_write_back.description: Ranked OFF < COMMENT < VEX < ANALYSIS; may only be equal to or lower than the policy, a higher value is lowered (architecture.md 5.4a i).

link_ttl.description: ISO 8601 duration (days, hours, minutes, seconds). Default reach.s3.link-ttl (PT24H); capped at reach.s3.link-ttl-max (proposed P7D).
